date.as_written: śubhasamvat 969 miti caitraṛṣṇa2 ... māse tu caitrakṛṣṇe caḥ dvitīyāyāṃ, śubhe tithau || nakṣatre svātisaṃyukte

notes: No individual scribe, commissioner, or reigning king is named. The text mentions that the copy was caused to be made for one's own observance/fulfillment of dharma (dharmapāraṇā-svārtham).
